card.name: Linking words inside combination drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "and" or a comma right after a drug name, where a second drug name follows in a combination product or co-administration. Also a few other joiners like "a" or "of" before a drug or dose.

modes.label: And between drug names
modes.description: The word "and" joins two drug names in a combination product title or interaction statement.

modes.description: A comma separates drug names in a three-drug combination.

modes.label: Other joiners before dose or drug
modes.description: A small word like "a" or "of" just before a dose or drug name.
modes.example: Pediatric patients older than three years of age:<< a>> single dose of 50 mg/kg

card.plain: It fires on the little word linking one drug to the next in combination products, right before the second drug's name.
